schemes.title: ONGC Scholarship Scheme for SC / ST / OBC / EWS Students in Professional Courses
schemes.description: Merit-based scholarship of ₹48,000 per year by ONGC Foundation to first-year students pursuing Engineering, MBBS, MBA, or Master in Geosciences across India, with 50 percent reservation for girl students.

schemes.title: Reliance Foundation Undergraduate Scholarship
schemes.description: Up to ₹2,00,000 total grant (₹50,000/year over 4 years) supporting first-year undergraduate students in any discipline based on merit, aptitude test and household financial need.

schemes.title: Reliance Foundation Postgraduate Scholarship
schemes.description: Prestigious fellowship of up to ₹6,00,000 total (₹3,00,000/year) for first-year postgraduate students pursuing cutting-edge STEM degrees including Artificial Intelligence, Computing and Energy Sciences.

schemes.title: LIC Golden Jubilee Scholarship Scheme
schemes.department: Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC Golden Jubilee Foundation)
schemes.description: Scholarship of ₹20,000 to ₹40,000 per annum by LIC of India for meritorious students from economically weaker families pursuing higher studies in government or recognized private colleges.
